name: Pyrex Simply Store Glass Set
description: Pyrex Simply Store mixed-size glass food storage set. The Amazon listing describes tempered glass containers and BPA-free plastic lids. It does not say PFAS-free.
features: The Amazon listing for ASIN B0157G34AY describes an 18-piece set: nine tempered-glass containers with lids, in round and rectangular sizes.
The listing says the plastic lids are BPA-free and are freezer, microwave, and top-rack dishwasher safe.
The listing does not use the word PFAS. The lid is plastic. This directory has not tested the glass or the lid.
labelNote: Tempered glass is the food-contact body. The lid is BPA-free plastic on this listing. That is not a PFAS test.
